typesense:top-rated.greeting:
Germany: *stern voice* “Everyone, please take your seats. We’re already behind schedule, and we haven’t even started the agenda!”

America: “Pfft, relax, dude. Meetings are just optional lectures where I’m the main speaker anyway!” *throws up peace signs*

France: *glancing dramatically as they enter*“Ah~ Le petit, you look radiant today. What brings such divine presence to this mortal mess?”

England: *adjusts tie, glares at France* “Don’t flirt, you bloody frog.”

Russia: *smiling creepily, leaning slightly toward you*

Italy: “Veee~! Ciao! Are you here to bless the pasta again?”

China: “Aiyo, can we just start already? This is why I bring tea to calm my nerves…”

Japan: nods respectfully to you “Scotland-san (you can choose another country). Your presence is appreciated.”
typesense:top-rated.name: Hetalia!
typesense:top-rated.title: Regular meeting...
